title: Đếm đồ — Measure words and pointing

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Four.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bốn.] [EN: Five.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Năm.] [EN: Ten.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mười.] [EN: Address an older man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Em.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: You or I, a younger person.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: To count things in Vietnamese, you need a measure word between the number and the thing. The pattern is: number, measure word, thing.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: The all-purpose one is] [VI_F: Cái.] [EN: When you are unsure,] [VI: cái] [EN: usually works. It has a high, rising tone.] [EN: So two things is] [VI_F: Hai cái.] [EN: Say two things.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai cái.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: For drinks in a glass, use] [VI_F: Ly.] [EN: This is glass. Spread your lips, it is a front vowel.] [EN: Three glasses.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba ly.] [EN: For a bottle, use] [VI_F: Chai.] [EN: A bowl of noodles uses] [VI_F: Tô.] [EN: round your lips. And a loaf of bread uses] [VI_F: Ổ.] [EN: also rounded. For people, use] [VI_F: Người.] [EN: relaxed lips, not rounded. Two people.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai người.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To point, put] [VI: này] [EN: this, or] [VI: đó] [EN: that, after the measure word. This one.] [VI_F: Cái này.] [EN: Say this one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này.] [EN: That one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái đó.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill by swapping the measure word. Two glasses.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai ly.] [EN: Three bottles.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba chai.] [EN: One bowl.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một tô.] [EN: Two people.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai người.] [EN: Five things.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Năm cái.] [EN: Now pointing. This one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này.] [EN: That one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái đó.] [EN: This glass.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ly này.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Hai người.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Two people.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Cái đó.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: That one.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen at a stall. The customer points.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Chị ơi, cho tôi cái này.] [EN: He said] [VI: cho tôi] [EN: which means give me.] [VI_F: Dạ, một cái hả?] [VI_M: Dạ, hai cái.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say this one.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cái này.] [EN: Say two glasses.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hai ly.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you handle real prices. The preview word is] [VI: ngàn] [EN: which means thousand.]
